Statement (ii): "If residual sum of squares falls when an additional term is added, the value of the information criterion will fall." Is this universally true? Information criteria typically BIC = -2 ln L + k ln n (or k ln n + constant). If RSS falls, log-likelihood increases (for least squares with known variance), so -2 log L decreases.
